# Command Overviewsvg image

## Purpose and Scopesvg image

This page provides a comprehensive reference of all 12 command-line tools available in the Contexter system. Each command is a CLI entry point that wraps a specific implementation module to perform operations on project directories and context files.

For detailed documentation of individual commands including all options, examples, and output formats, see [Command Reference](/ray0404/Contexter/5-command-reference). For conceptual information about workflows and how commands interact, see [Workflows](/ray0404/Contexter/4-workflows).

---

## Command Categoriessvg image

Contexter's 12 commands are organized into four functional categories:

| Category | Commands | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Building** | `buildcontext`, `buildcontexthtml` | Package directories into context files |
| **Reconstruction** | `reconstructor`, `reconstructorhtml` | Rebuild directories from context files |
| **Update Management** | `updatecontext`, `updater`, `smartupdate`, `updatecontexthtml`, `updaterhtml` | Generate and apply patches for versioning |
| **Utilities** | `sanitizecontext`, `md2html`, `html2md` | Fix formatting and convert between formats |

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L35) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py40-52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L40-L52)

---

## Complete Command Referencesvg image

The following table lists all commands with their core functionality and target format:

| Command | Implementation Module | Input | Output | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `buildcontext` | `context_builder.py` | Directory | Markdown (`.md`) | Packages a project directory into a single Markdown context file with syntax highlighting |
| `buildcontexthtml` | `build_context_html.py` | Directory | HTML (`.html`) | Packages a project directory into a single HTML context file with styled code blocks |
| `reconstructor` | `reconstructor.py` | Markdown (`.md`) | Directory | Rebuilds a complete project directory structure from a Markdown context file |
| `reconstructorhtml` | `reconstructor_html.py` | HTML (`.html`) | Directory | Rebuilds a complete project directory structure from an HTML context file |
| `updatecontext` | `update_context.py` | 2× Markdown (`.md`) | Patch file (`.md`) | Generates a unified diff patch by comparing two Markdown context files |
| `updater` | `updater.py` | Markdown + Patch | Markdown (`.md`) | Applies a patch file to a Markdown context file |
| `smartupdate` | `smart_update.py` | 2× Directories or Markdown | Patch file (`.md`) | **(Recommended)** Generates high-efficiency patches using rsync delta algorithms |
| `updatecontexthtml` | `update_context_html.py` | 2× HTML (`.html`) | Patch file (`.md` or `.html`) | Generates a patch by comparing two HTML context files |
| `updaterhtml` | `updater_html.py` | HTML + Patch | HTML (`.html`) | Applies a patch file to an HTML context file |
| `sanitizecontext` | `sanitize_context.py` | Markdown (`.md`) | Markdown (`.md`) | **(New v2.0.0)** Fixes AI-generated Markdown by adding missing code fences and structure |
| `md2html` | `md2html.py` | Markdown (`.md`) | HTML (`.html`) | Converts any Markdown file to HTML format |
| `html2md` | `html2md.py` | HTML (`.html`) | Markdown (`.md`) | Converts any HTML file to Markdown format |

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py40-52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L40-L52) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L36) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L35)

## Command-to-Module Mappingsvg image

The following diagram shows how each CLI command maps to its implementation module through the entry points defined in `setup.py`:

**Diagram: CLI Entry Points to Implementation Modules**

Each command has a 1:1 mapping to a Python module. The entry points are registered in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py40-52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L40-L52) using the pattern `'command=module:main'`, where each module exposes a `main()` function that serves as the command's entry point.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py40-52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L40-L52) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L36)

## Command Workflow Diagramsvg image

This diagram shows how commands operate on different file formats and their relationships:

**Diagram: Command Workflows and Data Formats**

This diagram illustrates how commands transform between directories, context files, and patches. The dual-format architecture supports both Markdown and HTML workflows with conversion bridges between them.

## Command Feature Matrixsvg image

The following table shows which features are available for each command category:

| Feature | Markdown Commands | HTML Commands | Conversion Commands |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Build from directory | ✓ `buildcontext` | ✓ `buildcontexthtml` | — |
| Reconstruct to directory | ✓ `reconstructor` | ✓ `reconstructorhtml` | — |
| Generate patches | ✓ `updatecontext`, `smartupdate` | ✓ `updatecontexthtml` | — |
| Apply patches | ✓ `updater` | ✓ `updaterhtml` | — |
| AI output sanitization | ✓ `sanitizecontext` | — | — |
| Format conversion | — | — | ✓ `md2html`, `html2md` |
| Rsync-based updates | ✓ `smartupdate` | — | — |

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L35) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py40-52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L40-L52)

## Common Command Patternssvg image

All Contexter commands follow consistent patterns for invocation and behavior:

### Help Informationsvg image

Every command provides detailed usage information:

### Standard Input/Output Patternsvg image

Most commands follow a two-argument pattern:

Examples:

- `buildcontext ./myproject context.md`
- `reconstructor context.md ./rebuilt-project`
- `md2html context.md context.html`

### Update Commands Patternsvg image

Update commands require comparison of two inputs:

Example:

- `updatecontext old_context.md new_context.md changes.patch.md`

### Patch Application Patternsvg image

Updater commands require a base context and a patch:

Example:

- `updater target.md changes.patch.md updated.md`

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md37](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L37-L37)

## Dependencies Required by Commandssvg image

All commands depend on the following external libraries, as specified in the project configuration:

| Library | Purpose | Commands Using It |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `markdown` | Markdown parsing and HTML generation | Building, conversion, and update commands |
| `Pygments` | Syntax highlighting in code blocks | Building commands |
| `beautifulsoup4` | HTML parsing | HTML reconstruction and conversion |
| `markdownify` | HTML to Markdown conversion | `html2md`, HTML utilities |
| `patch` | Unified diff/patch operations | Update and updater commands |

These dependencies are automatically installed during package installation as specified in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29) and loaded through `requirements.txt` in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py11-12](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L11-L12)

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py11-12](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L11-L12)
